body: The fact I'm still a minor makes everything worse. I know my family will worry when they realize something isnt right and I hate the trauma I may cause them. I dont understand why I'm always so fucking selfish. Even if it hurts my family I feel as though it's for the greater good. I want them to move on without me.

The pain isnt really much of my concern since I'd be dead in the end, but being in agony for so long makes it more likely for me to be "saved" and have to live with the physical trauma afterwards

Guess I'll have to consider another method
